note: GLOBALCIT's Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (EUI, 2025), coding the law in force on 1 January 2024 (A06a GEO 12, 12-1, 15-16; A06b GEO 12, 12-1, 15-16; L05 GEO 21, 21-1): ordinary naturalisation after 10 years' residence; the applicant must give up other citizenships; a citizen loses the citizenship on voluntarily taking another (with exceptions). Reforms after that date are checked in the file's later sources, where a later source is given.

sources.title: GLOBALCIT Citizenship Law Dataset v3.0 (Vink, van der Baaren, Bauböck, Dzankic, Honohan, Manby; EUI Research Data, 2025), country-year-mode files, Georgia, 2024
sources.said: Person has been lawfully resident for 10 years. ... Renunciation of citizenship of another country required. ... Person acquires citizenship of a foreign country, except if person has obtained permission for retention of citizenship. Permission to retain Georgian nationality IS granted if there is deemed to be a genuine connection of that person with Georgia
